title: AI chat: replay recorded real-model conversations as regression tests (local and cloud tool-call shapes)

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: area:mcp
labels.description: MCP server and agent tooling (crates/app/src/mcp, camcraft-mcp skill)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

body:
The AI chat panel already has a scripted test transport (`ScriptedTransport` in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/ai_chat/mod.rs`) and about 25 tests: tool dispatch through the inbox, one Ctrl+Z per AI turn, cancel, offline-only policy, confirmation gates, the round cap, local vs cloud tool sets. Those scripts are hand-written: each `tool_use` is the shape the test author expected.

What is not covered: the shapes REAL models send. Local models (Ollama / LM Studio / llama.cpp, e.g. qwen3-coder) and cloud models differ in argument JSON (numbers as strings, extra or missing fields, unit words, several tool calls in one reply, a call to a tool from the other tool set). A change to the tool schema or the argument parser can break a real model's workflow while every scripted test stays green.

Proposal:
1. A recorded fixture format: one JSON file per conversation (user messages, each model reply with its raw tool calls, the expected document diff after each turn). The QA swarm brief q08 (AI panel with a local model) saves exactly this transcript per run.
2. A `ReplayTransport` (beside `ScriptedTransport`) that plays a recorded reply sequence back, and one test per fixture that drives the real panel and asserts the document after each turn (operations, key parameters, one undo step per turn, refusals shown).
3. Start with three recorded workflows: "add a finishing pass for the pocket walls" (local model), "make it climb with 0.2 mm stepdown" (edit one op only), and "delete every operation" (confirmation gate holds).

No network in the test: replay only. Recording happens outside the gate (QA runs).

**Done means:** a `ReplayTransport` and fixture format in the ui test tree, three recorded fixtures (at least one from a local model), each with a test that fails when the tool argument parser or dispatch changes the outcome, and a short note in the camcraft-mcp skill or docs on how to record a new fixture.
